list.descendantsPartial_one: at least {{count}} descendant; some branches are not loaded

diagram.label: Diagram of {{name}}
diagram.nodeHint: Arrow keys: up to the parent, down to the first child, left and right between siblings. Plus and minus expand and collapse the branch. Enter opens the record for editing.

listlink.title: View as list
listlink.body: The diagram has its alternative in a tree list, which works with the keyboard and screen readers. Your selection and collapsed branches are kept.

search.title: Search the org chart
search.body: Type to expand the branches with matches and highlight them. Enter jumps to the next match and Shift+Enter to the previous one.

node.title: Org chart items
node.body: Click to select and double-click to open the record for editing. With the keyboard, arrow keys move between items, Enter opens and Space selects.

zoom.title: Zoom and framing
zoom.body: Zoom in, zoom out or fit the diagram to the screen; Fit switches between a legible size, centered on the root, and the whole org chart. You can also use the mouse wheel, or drag the background or the minimap.

canvas.title: Org chart
canvas.body: Each card is an item of the hierarchy. Collapse or expand a branch to see how many descendants it has.
